# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please don't report security problems in public issues.

Report them privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/2B-4G10/MVT-GUI/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include what you found, how to reproduce it and the
version of the app (Mac or Windows) you used.

Problems in MVT itself, rather than in the Mac or Windows app, belong to
[the MVT project](https://github.com/mvt-project/mvt).

## Supported versions

Only the latest release receives fixes.
